Żywiec Brewery.fact: Founded in 1856 in the town of Żywiec, the brewery manufactures pale lager with a 5.5% alcohol volume. The brewery has the capacity of producing 5 million hectolitres a year, making it the largest brewery in Grupa Żywiec.
